title: Choir Of The Dying Machine
description: A detuned supersaw reese swarm voiced like a screaming choir, its formant vowel shifting while a stepped ladder-filter env squelches underneath. Over 32 cycles the bit depth collapses from clean to gritty, the detune fans wider in stepped jumps, and the swarm degrades into bit-crushed grit before looping back. Dry, no reverb or delay.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2>*4").s("supersaw")
    .unison(5)
    .detune("<0.3 0.5 0.4 0.9>/8")
    .vowel("<a e i o>/11")
    .lpf(saw.slow(13).range(320, 2400))
    .lpenv("<3 5 4 7>/7")
    .lpattack(0.01)
    .lpdecay(perlin.slow(16).range(0.04, 0.16))
    .resonance(saw.slow(23).range(6, 17))
    .ftype("ladder")
    .shape(saw.slow(29).range(0.1, 0.55))
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 5))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .gain(0.85)
)
